methods.name: setData
methods.doc: Replace all data

methods.name: appendData
methods.doc: Append data for streaming

methods.name: getData
methods.doc: Get current data

methods.name: setAxis
methods.doc: Update axis domain

methods.name: getAxis
methods.doc: Get a scale by axis key

methods.name: setOptions
methods.doc: Merge config updates. Arrays such as `series` replace by value.

methods.name: replaceOptions
methods.doc: Replace the chart config declaratively, resolving defaults again and dropping keys omitted from the new config. Solid wrappers use this for full `config` signal updates.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.doc: Get resolved config

methods.name: getTheme
methods.doc: Resolved theme after defaults, light/dark detection, and CSS variable overrides. Plugins should color against this rather than re-deriving palettes from `getOptions().theme`, which holds only the caller's partial overrides.

methods.name: getLegendItems
methods.doc: Resolved series legend model for application-owned headers, sidebars, or custom renderers. Colors follow the active theme and mark fields retain enough geometry to distinguish lines, areas, bands, bars, and points.

methods.name: refreshTheme
methods.doc: Re-resolve the theme against the container's current CSS cascade and repaint if anything changed. Charts already call this automatically when an attribute changes on `<html>`/`<body>` (the `[data-theme]` pattern) or the OS color scheme flips; call it manually only when tokens change through some other mechanism (for example a variable swapped on a mid-tree ancestor). No-ops when the resolved theme is value-identical.

methods.name: getLayout
methods.doc: Get current layout

methods.name: redraw
methods.doc: Force full redraw

methods.name: resize
methods.doc: Resize chart

methods.name: getSelection
methods.doc: The current persistent brush selection in data space, or `null`. Set by a `selection.mode: 'brush'` gesture or `setSelection()`. Safe to serialize; feed it back to `setSelection()` to restore.

methods.name: setSelection
methods.doc: Set or clear the persistent brush selection programmatically (`null` clears). Fires `selection:change` / `selection.onBrush` on a real change. Independent of `selection.mode`, so a zoom-mode chart can still carry a brush set from code.

methods.name: scrollToLatest
methods.doc: Resume live-follow and snap the X viewport to the newest data. With `streaming.follow` set this jumps to the trailing window; otherwise it resets X to the full data extent. Re-enables following after the user paused it by panning or zooming, and fires `follow:change`.

methods.name: isFollowing
methods.doc: Whether the X viewport is tracking new data (live) rather than pinned by a user pan/zoom (paused). Starts `true`; a horizontal pan or zoom sets it `false`; `scrollToLatest()` and a double-click reset set it `true`.

methods.name: destroy
methods.doc: Destroy and clean up all resources

methods.name: use
methods.doc: Register a plugin. Returns false when a plugin with the same id is already registered.

methods.name: on
methods.signature: on<K extends keyof ChartEventMap>(event: K, handler: ChartEventMap[K]): () => void
methods.doc: Subscribe to chart events

methods.name: setCursorDataX
methods.signature: setCursorDataX(dataX: number | null, origin?: CursorEventOrigin): void
methods.doc: Set cursor position from external source (sync/programmatic)

methods.name: getCursorSnapshot
methods.doc: Snapshot of all visible series at the current cursor position (or fallback). Allocates a fresh snapshot, use `getCursorSnapshotInto()` in the cursor hot path to reuse buffers.

methods.name: getCursorSnapshotInto
methods.doc: Zero-allocation variant of `getCursorSnapshot`. Mutates and returns `target`. The `target.points` array is grown but never shrunk; use `target.points.length` (after this call) as the row count.

methods.name: setHighlight
methods.doc: Set the highlighted series. Pass `null` to clear. Triggers a data-layer redraw (non-highlighted series dim per `highlight.dimOpacity`) and publishes to the sync group when `highlight.syncKey` is set. No-op when the value is unchanged.

methods.name: getHighlight
methods.doc: Currently highlighted series index, or `null`.

methods.name: setHighlightKey
methods.doc: Highlight by stable identity. Requires `highlight.getKey`; when no visible series resolves to the key the highlight is cleared.

methods.name: getHighlightKey
methods.doc: Currently highlighted stable identity key, or `null`.

methods.name: getStats
methods.doc: Lightweight diagnostics for benchmark demos and local debugging. Returns a copy so callers cannot mutate internal counters.

methods.name: container
methods.doc: The root DOM container

events.name: cursor:move
events.signature: 'cursor:move': ( dataX: number | null, dataIdx: number | null, origin: CursorEventOrigin, ) => void
events.doc: Cursor moved or left (null args on leave). Fires on the cursor hot path.
events.type: ( dataX: number | null, dataIdx: number | null, origin: CursorEventOrigin, ) => void

events.name: viewport:change
events.doc: An axis viewport changed via zoom/pan, with the axis key and new range.

events.name: data:update
events.doc: Data replaced or appended. The payload is the live store, do not mutate it.

events.name: options:update
events.doc: Config changed via `setOptions`/`replaceOptions`, with the resolved config.

events.name: theme:update
events.doc: The resolved theme changed through config, CSS variables, or color scheme.

events.name: follow:change
events.doc: Live-follow state toggled: `true` when the X viewport resumed tracking new data, `false` when a pan/zoom paused it. Drive a live/paused badge from this. See `isFollowing()` / `scrollToLatest()`.

events.name: resize
events.doc: Chart resized, with the new CSS-pixel dimensions.

events.name: click
events.doc: Reserved click event. Not currently emitted by the core (see the DX audit).

events.name: selection:change
events.doc: Persistent brush selection changed (`null` when cleared). Mirror of `selection.onBrush`.

events.name: drawData
events.doc: Emitted while the data layer paints, for canvas-level custom drawing without a plugin.

events.name: drawOverlay
events.doc: Emitted while the overlay layer paints, above the data.

scatter.name: xDataIndex
scatter.doc: Absolute column index for scatter X values. Defaults to column 0. Useful for tabular datasets where several scatter views share the same row identity but use different X/Y metric columns.

scatter.name: yDataIndex
scatter.doc: Absolute column index for scatter Y values. Preferred over `dataIndex`.

scatter.name: renderMode
scatter.doc: Preferred scatter render path. `auto` uses points until the density threshold.

scatter.name: pointShape
scatter.doc: Point shape for non-density scatter rendering. Default: 'circle'.

scatter.name: colorBy
scatter.doc: Colour points by a categorical or numeric column.

scatter.name: sizeBy
scatter.doc: Size points by a numeric column.

scatter.name: tooltipFields
scatter.doc: Extra columns to show in the default nearest-point tooltip.

scatter.name: heatmap
scatter.doc: Force heatmap (density) rendering for scatter plots regardless of point count

scatter.name: heatmapBinSize
scatter.doc: Heatmap bin size in CSS pixels (default: 1 = one bin per physical pixel)

scatter.name: heatmapGradient
scatter.doc: Density-to-colour ramp for heatmap rendering. Array of 2+ hex colours interpolated linearly in sRGB; `t = 0` → first stop, `t = 1` → last. Overrides `theme.heatmapGradient`, then `theme.sequentialPalette`.

types.name: ColumnarData
types.doc: Columnar data format: index 0 is always X values, indices 1..N are Y series. All arrays must have identical length. X values (index 0) MUST be sorted monotonically non-decreasing. This constraint enables O(log n) binary search for viewport culling, hit-testing, and cursor snapping.

types.name: ScaleType
types.doc: Scale kind for an axis. `time` treats X values as epoch milliseconds and formats ticks in the viewer's local timezone; `log` requires strictly positive domains. Defaults to `linear` when omitted on an axis.

types.name: ScaleRange
types.doc: A closed data-space interval. `min` and `max` are in data units, not pixels.

types.name: Scale
types.doc: A Scale is a pure function pair: dataToPixel and pixelToData. Scales own a data domain and a pixel range, and convert between them.

types.name: ChartType
types.doc: Mark type for a series. `band` needs `upperDataIndex`/`lowerDataIndex`; `histogram` expects pre-binned N+1 edges data. Defaults to `line`.

types.name: ScatterRenderMode
types.doc: Scatter draw path. `points` always draws individual marks; `density` always draws a binned heatmap; `auto` (the default) draws points until the visible count crosses the internal density threshold, then switches.

types.name: ScatterPointShape
types.doc: Mark glyph for non-density scatter rendering. Defaults to `circle`.

types.name: ScatterColorEncodingType
types.doc: How a `colorBy` column is interpreted. `auto` treats low-cardinality integer columns as categories and everything else as a continuous ramp.

types.name: InterpolationMode
types.doc: Line/area path interpolation. `monotone` is a shape-preserving cubic that never overshoots between points; the three `step-*` variants place the riser before, after, or centered on each point. Defaults to `linear`.

types.name: AxisGridConfig
types.doc: Per-axis gridline styling, independent of tick labels. `false` (or `show: false`) removes this axis's gridlines while its labels stay; a time-bar chart often wants horizontal guides only, so set `axes.x.grid: false`. Colors here are concrete CSS color strings; theme `var()` references are resolved only in `ThemeConfig` fields.

types.name: AxisTickMarksConfig
types.doc: Styling for the short marks that anchor tick labels to exact scale positions.

types.name: AxisConfig
types.doc: Configuration for an axis entry in ChartConfig.axes

types.name: InteractionMode
types.doc: Interaction modes define default gesture→action mappings: - timeseries: mouse drag=box-zoom, shift+drag=pan, pinch=zoom-x - analytical: mouse drag=box-zoom, shift+drag=pan, pinch=zoom-xy - readonly: tooltip only, all navigation disabled (reports, embeds) Touch defaults are cursor-first: one-finger drag moves the cursor, double-tap+drag selects, and two-finger pinch zooms.

types.name: ZoomBoundsSpec
types.doc: Per-axis bounds for zoom and pan. `'data'` tracks the current data extent; an explicit `{ min?, max? }` pins custom limits (use `undefined` on one side for half-open bounds).

types.name: SelectedPoint
types.doc: A single scatter point captured inside a box selection.

types.name: TooltipPoint
types.doc: One row passed to a custom `tooltip.render`.

types.name: TooltipFieldValue
types.doc: One extra scatter column value in a tooltip row.

types.name: LegendItem
types.doc: Resolved, renderer-independent description of one series legend entry.

types.name: CursorSeriesPoint
types.doc: One row of a cursor snapshot, the value of a single visible series at a given X index, plus everything the legend table needs to render it.

types.name: CursorSnapshot
types.doc: Snapshot of all visible series at a given cursor (or fallback) index. Returned by `chart.getCursorSnapshot()` and consumed by the legend table. Safe to read on every `cursor:move`: the `points` array is reused across calls (mutated in place) when you use `getCursorSnapshotInto()`.

types.name: CursorSnapshotOptions
types.doc: Options accepted by `getCursorSnapshot()` and the reactive primitive.

types.name: HighlightSyncKey
types.doc: Stable cross-chart identity for a series, returned by `highlight.getKey`. Lets linked charts with different series order highlight the same logical run/metric.

types.name: HighlightSyncPayload
types.doc: Wire format broadcast over a highlight sync group. `index` carries a raw `seriesIndex` (identical-order charts); `key` carries a `getKey` identity that each receiver maps to its own local series. `null` clears.

types.name: DeepPartial
types.doc: Recursively optional version of `T`, with arrays replaced wholesale rather than merged element-wise. This is the shape `setOptions()` accepts, so a `series` array in a partial update replaces the existing series list.

types.name: ThemeConfig
types.doc: Chart color and typography tokens. Every color field accepts any CSS color the browser can compute, including `var(--token)` references and `oklch(...)`: values are resolved against the chart container when the theme is applied, and re-resolved automatically when the document theme changes (an attribute flip on `<html>`/`<body>` or an OS color-scheme change), so charts in a CSS-variable design system re-theme live with no remount. Alternatively define the `--chart-*` custom properties (see `CHART_CSS_VARS`) on the container and omit `theme` entirely.

types.name: CursorEventOrigin
types.doc: What produced a cursor change. `local` is this chart's own pointer; `sync` came from a peer over a sync group; `programmatic` came from `setCursorDataX`. Handlers use it to break sync feedback loops.

types.name: ChartEventMap
types.doc: Event name to handler-signature map for `chart.on()`.

types.name: RenderContext
types.doc: The resolved state handed to renderers for one paint. Read-only per frame.

solidTypes.name: LegendTableFallback
solidTypes.doc: Mirrors the plugin's fallback union (re-exported for ergonomics).

solidTypes.name: LegendTableSolidColumn
solidTypes.doc: Solid-flavored column definition. The cell receives the snapshot row, the series config, and (optionally) the highlight setter so a row's cell can drive cross-chart highlighting from a button or link. If you don't need JSX in cells, the same `LegendTableColumn` from the plugin works fine and is forwarded through `columns`.

solidTypes.name: ChartGroupBindings
solidTypes.doc: Bindings spread into each chart in the group. Always sets matching `cursor.syncKey` and `highlight.syncKey`; `zoom.syncKey` is only included when zoom sync is opted into (`bind({ zoom: true })`), so grouping does not silently link every chart's zoom.

solidTypes.name: ChartGroupBindOptions
solidTypes.doc: Options controlling which channels a group binding links.

solidTypes.name: ChartGroup
solidTypes.doc: A handle to a coordinated set of charts that share cursor + highlight state. Spread `group.bind()` into each chart's config, that is the entire wiring step. ```tsx const group = createChartGroup(); <Chart config={{ ...group.bind(), series, axes }} data={a} /> <Chart config={{ ...group.bind(), series, axes }} data={b} /> <button onMouseEnter={() => group.highlight(2)}>Run #2</button> ``` `group.highlight()` and `group.cursor()` push state to every chart via the existing SyncGroup registry. Reads (`group.highlightedSeries`) reflect the last broadcast originating from the group itself, * peer-originated changes still flow through each chart's own `'highlight:change'` event (use `createHighlight` to track those).
